# Goalchemy

> Goalchemy compiles a restricted, Go-compatible source language into native programs and SDK libraries for multiple languages. Shared SDK logic stays in Go source; target runtimes and host capabilities preserve its specified behavior.

Documentation: https://goalchemy.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy

Use this file as a navigation guide. Linked repository documents are readable Markdown and track main, as does the documentation site. Root-relative links in documentation sources refer to https://goalchemy.dev/. For an installed release, run `goalchemy version` and consult the same documents at its matching Git tag. Read the linked references for current flags, defaults, supported features, dependencies, and limitations.

When helping with Goalchemy:

- Ordinary Go compilation does not establish compatibility with the Goalchemy subset. Check source with `goalchemy check` using the intended language gate, and inspect `goalchemy features` for the installed compiler.
- Use documented Goalchemy `std/` packages for portable library logic and `lib/` capabilities for host operations. Familiar package names do not imply support for the entire Go standard library.
- Select a non-main root package to produce an SDK library. Source language support and types accepted across a target's native public boundary are separate concerns.
- Consult the usage and target references before selecting a pause model or naming mode. Read the generated README and goalchemy.manifest.json for the actual output's build instructions and compiler information.
- Change shared source and regenerate output instead of maintaining independent edits to generated target code. Verify behavior from a native consumer when changing an SDK boundary.

## Language and runtime

- [Language specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/specs/language.md): Authoritative accepted subset, evaluation rules, value semantics, and language gates.
- [Feature matrix](https://goalchemy.dev/language/features/): Published feature support generated from the checked manifest; use the installed compiler's features command for release-specific support.
- [Runtime API reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs/library.md): Portable packages, host capabilities, function signatures, and behavioral contracts.
- [Limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/language/limitations.md): Source restrictions, public API limits, and target support boundaries.
- [Diagnostics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/specs/diagnostics.md): Diagnostic categories, source spans, and remedies.

## Building SDKs

- [Building an SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/guides/building-an-sdk.md): Native library boundaries, packaging, ownership, and consumer verification.
- [Portable source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/guides/portable-source.md): Structure shared code around supported semantics and capabilities.
- [Concurrency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/guides/concurrency.md): Cooperative tasks, channels, cancellation, and language-gate selection.
- [Stateful library handles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs/library-handles.md): Retained state, instances, callbacks, streams, and resource lifetimes.
- [Host operations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs/host-operations.md): Native operation ownership, completion, and cancellation cleanup.
- [Protobuf and Connect](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs/protobuf.md): Generate subset-Go messages, JSON codecs, and service clients from protocol definitions.

## Target guides

- [Target overview](https://goalchemy.dev/targets/): Compare output formats and prerequisites; follow each guide's links to detailed boundary and runtime references.
- [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/go.md): Go output and native library integration.
- [TypeScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/typescript.md): JavaScript environments, values, and package integration.
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/python.md): Python output, dependencies, and public APIs.
- [Java](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/java.md): JVM output and library integration.
- [C#](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/csharp.md): .NET output and library integration.
- [Rust](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/rust.md): Rust packages, native dependencies, and library integration.
- [C](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs-web/src/content/docs/targets/c.md): Native build requirements, memory management, and library boundaries; verify platform suitability here.
- [Swift](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eugenioenko/goalchemy/main/docs/swift-target.md): Current support status, native prerequisites, SwiftPM integration, and library APIs.
